messages.subject: Color issues plotting from shapefile
parts:
I'm getting strange behavior plotting a map from a shapefile- specifically the following problems:

1) the colors are off
2) the aesthetics that I add from a subsequent geom_point layer seem to affect the map itself.

Below is the reproducible example for problem 1), though I suspect someone may be able to provide a diagnosis simply by looking at the attached plot output-- ie, I think I'm missing something fundamental.  Note that I closely followed code from the Kahle-Wickham paper linked here.

library("ggplot2")
library("maptools")

download.file('https://njgin.state.nj.us/oit/gis/download/bounds_nj_shp.zip', destfile = 'jersey_shapefile.zip')
unzip('jersey_shapefile.zip')
data <- fortify(readShapeSpatial('nj_counties.shp')) ##Assumes download dest in in search path

my_map <- ggplot( data = data, aes(x = long, y = lat)) + geom_polygon(aes(group = group, color = 'white', fill = 'black', alpha = .4, size = .3))

my_map

my output looks like the attachment.  The data seems right (it's New Jersey), but note that the color isn't white, and the fill isn't black...

As for problem 2), I'm also having similar color/ alpha issues as I add points to the plot using geom_point()- ie, the colors aren't right AND they seem to affect the base layer map aesthetics.

my_map + geom_point(data = some_data, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = "green", size = 3, alpha = .1))

Finally, I'm using 64-bit R version 3.1.0 through RStudio version 0.98.507 on a late model Apple MacBook Pro running OS 10.9.3.

Help is much appreciated.

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Color issues plotting from shapefile
parts:
aes() is for mapping variables to aesthetics. Setting aesthetics to fixed values should be done outside of the aes() calls, e.g.,

geom_polygon(aes(group = group), color = 'white', fill = 'black', alpha = .4, size = .3)

Best,
Ista
